svg.title: Task & Problem Setting
svg.desc: Goal: translate molecular graphs into natural language descriptions (structural properties, functional groups). Challenge: a multimodal task requiring alignment between graph representation learning and NLP. Metrics: BLEU-4 (n-gram precision) and BERTScore (semantic similarity). Input data: nodes (atoms) with 9 features (atomic number, chirality, charge and others), and edges (bonds) with 3 features (bond type, stereo, conjugation).
